differential.name: End‑stage renal disease on hemodialysis secondary to diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Advanced CKD (stage 4) with dialysis weight loss, high creatinine, hypertension, proteinuria and diabetes explain the overall picture.

differential.name: Renal osteodystrophy (secondary hyperparathyroidism)
differential.rationale: Elevated alkaline phosphatase, metabolic acidosis, and moderate bone‑type pain are typical in CKD‑MBD.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Documented anemia in the setting of CKD and reduced erythropoietin production.

differential.name: Hyperkalemia related to impaired renal excretion
differential.rationale: Serum potassium 5.2 mmol/L in a dialysis patient indicates a common electrolyte complication contributing to symptoms.

differential.name: Major depressive disorder secondary to intimate partner abuse
differential.rationale: Limited social contact, abuse history, and chronic illness increase risk of depression, which can amplify pain perception.
